plates.quality_reason: Flow-first: a teach diagram, chart, counter or timeline is a £0 code graphic. No Flow mint.
plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked gnotobiotic isolator physiology chart from Reyniers (1946) and Gustafsson (1948, 1959, Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences) compares germ-free vs conventional rodents across 4 metrics: caecum weight (5× larger in germ-free), daily caloric intake (+30% higher in germ-free), clotting time without dietary Vitamin K (lethal haemorrhage in germ-free vs normal clotting in colonized within 24–48 h), and intestinal lymphoid tissue (severely underdeveloped in germ-free).

teach_overlay.scale: raising a mouse without gut bacteria is like trying to run a city without power plants, recycling crews, or a fire brigade — the mouse has to eat nearly a third more food just to stay warm, and a tiny scratch can bleed uncontrollably without bacterial Vitamin K
